youtube_title: Same Topper in EVERY Coaching Ad? 🤨 #Shorts
youtube_description:
One topper, five coaching posters. How?

The consumer authority (CCPA) found one big UPSC institute advertised 100+ successful candidates, but only 3 had taken its full foundation course. The rest had used a test series or a mock interview. Fine: ₹11 lakh. So far CCPA has fined 28 coaching institutes over ₹1 crore in total.

Before admission, ask: which course did this topper actually take?

Source: CCPA orders on misleading coaching ads (reported by IANS, Dec 2025).
